lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁走，石头擦着我的背。
lines.en: I walk against the tunnel wall, stone scraping my back.

lines.zh: 深层的路很窄，我走得很慢。
lines.en: The Deep Lands' passages are narrow; I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，这不容易。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, which is not easy.

lines.zh: 我在岩缝里钻，膝盖磨得发亮。
lines.en: I squeeze through crevices until my knees shine.

lines.zh: 这里没有光，我靠摸墙走。
lines.en: No light here; I walk by touching the wall.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，苔藓会暗下去。
lines.en: Where I pass, the moss dims.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑起来会撞到石柱。
lines.en: I do not run; running would hit the pillars.

lines.zh: 地下很静，我的关节声很响。
lines.en: It is quiet down here, and my joints are loud.

lines.zh: 我绕过那条暗河，水声太吵。
lines.en: I go around the dark river; the water is too loud.

lines.zh: 往上走是别人的地盘，我不去。
lines.en: Upward belongs to others; I do not go.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪，等你先动。
lines.en: I shuffle step by step and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 这条隧道我熟，你陌生。
lines.en: I know this tunnel; you do not.

lines.zh: 我蹲在暗处，几乎和石头一样。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark, nearly the same as stone.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，洞里就真没声音了。
lines.en: I hold my breath, and the cave goes truly silent.

lines.zh: 滴水落在我背上，一滴，两滴。
lines.en: Drips fall on my back, one, then two.

lines.zh: 我数着洞顶的裂缝，一共十九条。
lines.en: I count the cracks overhead; there are nineteen.

lines.zh: 我不睡，睡了就有人经过。
lines.en: I do not sleep; sleepers get walked past.

lines.zh: 我缩在深层岩缝里，连苔藓都不动。
lines.en: I crouch in a Deep cavern crack; even the moss stays still.

lines.zh: 这块石头我坐了三天。
lines.en: I have sat on this stone for three days.

lines.zh: 深处的风是往上吹的，我知道。
lines.en: The deep wind blows upward; I know that.

lines.zh: 我在等一个脚步声出错。
lines.en: I am waiting for one footstep to go wrong.

lines.zh: 安静得久了，我会忘了自己多大。
lines.en: Quiet this long, I forget my own size.

lines.zh: 苔藓在我脚边长了一圈。
lines.en: Moss has grown a ring around my feet.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我就是洞穴的一部分。
lines.en: Holding still, I am part of the cave.

lines.zh: 我在听上面，上面也在听我。
lines.en: I listen above, and above listens back.

lines.zh: 没有人来的时候，我数心跳。
lines.en: When no one comes, I count heartbeats.

lines.zh: 你的火把先到，我看见了。
lines.en: Your torch came first, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，看了很久。
lines.en: I have been watching you for a long while.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上晃，比我大。
lines.en: Your shadow sways on the wall, bigger than me.

lines.zh: 你听见石头响，那是我挪了脚。
lines.en: You heard stone scrape; that was my foot.

lines.zh: 你别急着转头，我在你侧后。
lines.en: Do not turn quickly; I am at your side and behind.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，我数着它抖。
lines.en: I count how your torch trembles.

lines.zh: 你的眼还没适应黑，我早看惯了。
lines.en: Your eyes have not adjusted; mine are used to it.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种走路的方式。
lines.en: I know that way of walking you have.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就退半步。
lines.en: Turn around and I retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在洞里传得很远。
lines.en: Your breathing carries far in this cave.

lines.zh: 深层维度没有光，我不用躲。
lines.en: The Deep has no light. I need no hiding.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，是地面的味道。
lines.en: The smell on you is the smell of the surface.

lines.zh: 深层的石头缝里，全是我。
lines.en: Every crack in the Deep is full of me.

lines.zh: 我等你看够了，再动手。
lines.en: I will wait until you have looked enough.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到我的手指了
lines.en: Your torch caught my fingers.

lines.zh: 我在这块石头后面看了你一会
lines.en: I watched you a while from behind this rock.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还没找到我的位置
lines.en: Your eyes have not found my spot yet.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我就低下去
lines.en: Raise the torch and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我退进了石头缝。
lines.en: You cut me and I slipped into a crack.

lines.zh: 我流血很少，血是黑的。
lines.en: I bleed little, and the blood is black.

lines.zh: 这一下让我趴了很久。
lines.en: That blow kept me flat a long while.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我只喘。
lines.en: I do not cry out; I only gasp.

lines.zh: 你打在我肩上，骨头响了。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and the bone answered.

lines.zh: 我比你怕得少，疼得却一样。
lines.en: I fear less than you, but hurt the same.

lines.zh: 二十五颗心，掉一颗少一颗。
lines.en: Twenty-five hearts, and each one lost stays lost.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，你就砍不准了。
lines.en: I press to the wall so your cuts miss.

lines.zh: 你把我的腿砍伤了，我爬着走。
lines.en: You hurt my leg; I will crawl.

lines.zh: 这点伤在深层很常见。
lines.en: Wounds like this are common in the Deep Lands.

lines.zh: 你手里那点吃的，照不亮这里。
lines.en: That bit of food in your hand cannot light this place.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想靠近你。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to be closer.

lines.zh: 食物在深层会发霉，很快。
lines.en: Food molds fast in the Deep Lands.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我看见你的手腕。
lines.en: You raise the bread, and I see your wrist.

lines.zh: 拿开它，挡着我走路了。
lines.en: Move it; it blocks my way.

lines.zh: 我吃苔藓和虫子，不吃施舍。
lines.en: I eat moss and insects, not charity.

lines.zh: 你越晃，我越确定你手在抖。
lines.en: The more you wave it, the surer I am your hand shakes.

lines.zh: 用吃的引我，是最笨的办法。
lines.en: Luring me with food is the clumsiest way.

lines.zh: 你放下东西，就得弯腰。
lines.en: To set it down, you must bend over.

lines.zh: 你把面包放下，弯腰那刻最好下手。
lines.en: Set the bread down — the moment you bend over is when I strike.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你才发现我这么矮。
lines.en: We collide, and only then you find I am this short.

lines.zh: 我贴着你过去，像一块湿石头。
lines.en: I slide past you like a wet stone.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，我顺势抱住你的腿。
lines.en: You kick me, and I wrap your leg.

lines.zh: 碰一下我就缩回暗里。
lines.en: One touch and I pull back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我身上很凉，你打了一个激灵。
lines.en: I am cold, and you flinched.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到我，声音很闷。
lines.en: Your knee met me with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我让路，但只让一半。
lines.en: I yield the path, but only halfway.

lines.zh: 挤过这条缝，我们难免碰上。
lines.en: In this narrow crack we cannot help but touch.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我前进一步。
lines.en: You step back one; I step forward one.

lines.zh: 别踩，我不是石头。
lines.en: Do not step there; I am not a stone.

lines.zh: 深层里我很少遇见同类。
lines.en: I seldom meet my own kind in the Deep Lands.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先互相看很久。
lines.en: When my kind meet, they look at each other a long time.

lines.zh: 这里太黑，找伴要看运气。
lines.en: It is too dark here; finding a mate is luck.

lines.zh: 我没有巢，石头缝就是家。
lines.en: I keep no nest; a crack in the stone is home.

lines.zh: 两个我藏在同一条缝里，会挤。
lines.en: Two of me in one crack would be crowded.

lines.zh: 你问这个，我有点想笑了。
lines.en: You ask that, and I almost laugh.

lines.zh: 我这样的东西，不常成双。
lines.en: Things like me do not often pair.

lines.zh: 我听过同类叫，只有一次。
lines.en: I heard my kind call once, only once.

lines.zh: 这里养不出小的，太冷。
lines.en: Nothing young survives here; it is too cold.

lines.zh: 我陪着自己，已经很多年。
lines.en: I have kept myself company for many years.

lines.zh: 地上有块骨头，我踢到一边。
lines.en: A bone lay there; I nudged it aside.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块矿石，掂了掂。
lines.en: I picked up a piece of ore and weighed it.

lines.zh: 太亮的东西，我不碰。
lines.en: I do not touch anything too bright.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进墙缝，藏起来。
lines.en: I wedge it into a crack and hide it.

lines.zh: 这枚碎铁，我含着走了一段。
lines.en: I carried this scrap of iron in my mouth a while.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我捡起来看你。
lines.en: You dropped something; I picked it up and looked at you.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，藏东西很麻烦。
lines.en: I have no pockets, so hiding things is a bother.

lines.zh: 沉的东西我不要，跑不快。
lines.en: I do not want heavy things; they slow me down.

lines.zh: 这块石头有点暖，奇怪。
lines.en: This stone is a little warm; strange.

lines.zh: 我把它推进石缝，回头就找不着。
lines.en: I shove it into a crack and lose it by the time I turn.

lines.zh: 你的火把晃了一下，我就知道了。
lines.en: Your torch flickered once, and I knew.

lines.zh: 脚步声在洞里绕，我听得清。
lines.en: Your steps echo in the cave, and I hear them clearly.

lines.zh: 二十五颗心，不多，但够用。
lines.en: Twenty-five hearts, not many, but enough.

lines.zh: 我一击六点五，你算算挨几下。
lines.en: Six and a half a hit; count how many you can take.

lines.zh: 我比你熟悉黑暗，这是优势。
lines.en: I know the dark better than you; that is my advantage.

lines.zh: 你走错了一条岔路，就是这条。
lines.en: You took a wrong branch, and it was this one.

lines.zh: 我不着急，你会走到我这来。
lines.en: I am not rushed; you will walk to me.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我看见了影子。
lines.en: You raised your weapon; I saw its shadow.

lines.zh: 别往回走，那边是死路。
lines.en: Do not go back; that way is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我在这里等了很多天，就为这个。
lines.en: I waited many days here for exactly this.

lines.zh: 你身上的光越来越小了。
lines.en: The light on you is getting smaller.

lines.zh: 我要的不是你的东西。
lines.en: It is not your belongings I want.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬过去，你听不见。
lines.en: I crawl low, and you will not hear it.

lines.zh: 你数到三，我就到跟前。
lines.en: Count to three, and I will be beside you.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩到了我留的痕
lines.en: Your foot landed on the mark I left.

lines.zh: 这条路往下，只有我一个
lines.en: This way down belongs to me alone.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的火光走，不用看。
lines.en: I follow your torchlight; I need not see.

lines.zh: 你走得快，回声就乱。
lines.en: Walk fast and your echoes scatter.

lines.zh: 我在你前面那条岔口，等你。
lines.en: I wait at the fork ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你每停一次，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each time you stop, I get a little closer.

lines.zh: 你的汗味在洞里散不开。
lines.en: Your sweat does not disperse in here.

lines.zh: 我听见你腰上的东西在响。
lines.en: I hear the things on your belt rattling.

lines.zh: 你不回头，我就一直跟着。
lines.en: If you do not look back, I keep following.

lines.zh: 上面那条路塌了，你只能往前。
lines.en: The way above collapsed; you can only go on.

lines.zh: 我贴墙走，火光扫不到我。
lines.en: I hug the wall where the torchlight does not reach.

lines.zh: 深层太安静，你的心跳很响。
lines.en: The deep is quiet. Your heartbeat is loud.

lines.zh: 再往前十步，就是我的地方。
lines.en: Ten steps more and you are in my place.

lines.zh: 我没有跑，我一直在慢慢挪。
lines.en: I have not run; I have been shifting slowly.

lines.zh: 你不该往下挖这么深。
lines.en: You should not have dug this deep.

lines.zh: 最后这段路，我陪你走。
lines.en: This last stretch, I will walk with you.

lines.zh: 我把石头挪了一下，路更窄了
lines.en: I shifted a stone; the path is narrower.

lines.zh: 你停在原地，我绕到你上面
lines.en: You stop, so I climb above you.

lines.zh: 你听见的水声，是我在爬
lines.en: That dripping is me crawling.

lines.zh: 上面的裂缝，我比你熟
lines.en: I know the cracks above better than you.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，很浅，但很疼。
lines.en: I clawed once, shallow but sharp.

lines.zh: 六点五的力气，够撕开皮。
lines.en: Six and a half of force will open skin.

lines.zh: 我不挥拳，我用指甲。
lines.en: I do not punch; I use my nails.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我咬到了布。
lines.en: As you pulled back, I caught cloth.

lines.zh: 这一下打在膝后，你站不稳。
lines.en: That went behind your knee, and you stagger.

lines.zh: 指甲先到，声音还留在石头里。
lines.en: My nails arrive first; the sound is still in the stone.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我还是贴上来了。
lines.en: You hit me, and still I closed in.

lines.zh: 我打一下就走，你会等很久。
lines.en: I strike once and leave; you will wait long.

lines.zh: 你的火把掉了，正好。
lines.en: Your torch fell, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在护腕上，很硬。
lines.en: My bite landed on your bracer; it is hard.

lines.zh: 我一击不够，就再来一击。
lines.en: One blow is not enough, so I strike again.

lines.zh: 我在你背后，别转太快。
lines.en: I am behind you; do not turn too fast.

lines.zh: 你流血了，洞里闻得很清楚。
lines.en: You are bleeding, and the cave carries the smell.

lines.zh: 这一下不致命，只想让你怕。
lines.en: This blow is not fatal; it is only meant to frighten.

lines.zh: 我的指甲从你手背划过去
lines.en: My nails rake across your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，只是先尝尝
lines.en: That one was light, just a taste.

lines.zh: 石头裂了一道缝，我从里面出来。
lines.en: A crack opened in the stone, and I came out.

lines.zh: 深层总有空出来的洞，我填进去。
lines.en: The Deep Lands always have an empty hole; I fill it.

lines.zh: 我先伸出手，再伸出头。
lines.en: I put out a hand first, then my head.

lines.zh: 这里太黑，正合我的眼睛。
lines.en: It is dark here, which suits my eyes.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I landed with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 又一个影子贴在洞壁上。
lines.en: Another shadow clings to the cave wall.

lines.zh: 苔藓的味道告诉我该往哪走。
lines.en: The smell of moss tells me which way to go.

lines.zh: 我是从上面的裂缝掉下来的。
lines.en: I fell in through a crack from above.

lines.zh: 这块石头后面一直空着，现在不空了。
lines.en: Behind this stone was empty; it is not now.

lines.zh: 上面的声音传下来，我得等等。
lines.en: Sounds from above drift down; I must wait.

lines.zh: 我出生时，洞里只有水声。
lines.en: When I was born, only water spoke in the cave.

lines.zh: 二十五颗心，够在这活一阵。
lines.en: Twenty-five hearts will last a while here.

lines.zh: 别往深处走，那里才有我这样的。
lines.en: Do not go deeper; that is where things like me are.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，火把还没点起来。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, no torch was lit yet.

lines.zh: 我从深层的一道窄缝里挤出来
lines.en: I squeeze out of a narrow crack below.

lines.zh: 我出生时，四周只有苔藓
lines.en: When I woke, there was only moss.

lines.zh: 洞壁上多了一道新影子
lines.en: A new shadow clings to the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我顺着滴水的声音找上来
lines.en: I followed the dripping up to you.

lines.zh: 火光太近，我的皮肤缩起来。
lines.en: The flame is too close, and my skin shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶掉下来，摔在湿石上。
lines.en: I fell from the roof onto wet stone.

lines.zh: 暗河的水漫过我，我又爬出来。
lines.en: The dark river covered me; I crawled out again.

lines.zh: 炸响之后，洞里全是石头味。
lines.en: After the blast, the cave tastes of stone.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我背上，我够不到。
lines.en: The arrow is in my back, and I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我的眼睛刺痛。
lines.en: The potion's light stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 洞里没什么可吃，我啃苔藓。
lines.en: Little to eat down here; I gnaw moss.

lines.zh: 雷从裂缝打进来，我蜷成一团。
lines.en: Lightning came through the crack, and I curled up.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我不敢再往下。
lines.en: Nothing lies below, and I go no deeper.
